title: security: RBAC v2 - audit logging + KMS region pinning & residency enforcement
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: enforce RBAC v2 policies at control-plane and runtime to ensure KMS-backed key usage respects region residency constraints, and improve audit logging for all policy evaluation and KMS access events. This PR implements: 1) Extend RBAC v2 policy schema with kms_region constraints and residency enforcement flag; 2) Add audit hooks that log policy decisions (allow/deny/fallback) with stable structured fields for downstream ingestion; 3) Wire KMS client calls to include region pinning metadata and raise policy violations when cross-region requests are disallowed; 4) Migration shim that logs legacy key usage and emits a warning for keys without region metadata; 5) E2E tests + unit tests for policy evaluation, audit emission, and KMS client enforcement. Changeset summary and rationale: - Security teams require deterministic enforcement of data residency for customer keys. Previously we relied on best-effort routing and doc-level controls; this change moves enforcement into policy evaluation and KMS client layer. - We keep soft-audit mode enabled by default for 30 days (controlled by feature flag) to surface violations without blocking traffic; operators can flip to enforce mode per-account. - Audit logs are emitted to the existing event pipeline with a new event_type "rbac.kms.access" and include key_id, requested_region, allowed_regions, policy_id, decision, evaluator, request_id, and timestamp. - KMS clients validate region pinning at call time and return a structured error (RBAC_KMS_REGION_PINNING) which the gateway maps to 403. Checklist: - [x] Schema changes + validation - [x] Runtime enforcement path for gateway and private runtime - [x] Audit logging + event schema registered - [x] Feature flag + rollout plan - [x] Unit & integration tests - [x] Migration warnings and docs Impact and rollout: - Soft-audit rollout for 14 days in staging then 30 days in production with metrics monitored (policy_violations, audit_events_emitted, enforce_denials). - Breaking changes: none by default (soft-audit). Operators switching to residency-enforce mode will observe 403 on cross-region KMS usage. Testing: - Added unit tests for PolicyEvaluator (kms_region matchers), new event serializer, and KMS client validation. - Integration tests simulate cross-region KMS request and assert audit event + deny when enforcement enabled. Migration notes: - A migration scans existing keys, annotates key metadata with region when determinable, and records findings in audit index. - Customers with ambiguous key residency are notified; docs include remediation steps. Related: ENG-1245 tracks dashboarding and alerts for policy violations. See SUP-231 for a customer-reported cross-region key access case.
commits: Initial schema change for RBAC v2 kms_region field
PolicyEvaluator: kms_region matcher + residency enforcement path
KMS client: add region pinning validation + structured error
Audit: add rbac.kms.access event serializer and pipeline registration
Tests: unit + e2e for kms region enforcement
review_comments: Diego Alvarez: API looks good, but please add a small note about performance - evaluating region matchers on high-throughput paths could add overhead. Can we cache policy evaluation results for short TTL?
Maya Patel: Added LRU cache in evaluator with 1s TTL and metrics (rbac.evaluator.cache.hit/miss). See evaluator.go commit.
Priya Nair: Audit schema fields look fine. Please ensure PII is redacted (key material must never be logged). Confirmed with the audit team - we only include key_id and account_id.
Ethan Liu: KMS client change is invasive for private runtime. Add a feature flag to disable enforcement for private/offline deployments. Also add unit tests for offline fallback.
Maya Patel: Feature flag added (rbac.kms.residency.enforce.enabled) and defaulting behavior included in gateway handler. Private runtime disables enforcement by default in its config.
Diego Alvarez: Approving after addressing cache and feature flag comments.
release_notes: Added RBAC v2 kms_region constraints and residency enforcement with audit logging. Default rollout is soft-audit; operators can enable enforcement via feature flag. Includes migration tool to annotate existing keys.
